coverageNotes: Covers avoiding single-document growth. SDK descriptors and native size accounting compare the exact layouts. The existing separate-row schema supports real writes and independent updates; no alternate schema is installed. Does not benchmark contention or unlimited pagination.

questions.context: Convex 1.44.0. A task has a checklist that keeps growing over time. Each item has text and completed, and the app toggles individual items. Each item is small enough for a document; the combined checklist can exceed Convex’s single-document size limit.
questions.question: Which layout keeps every document from growing with the whole checklist?

options.text: One tasks document containing a checklist array of item objects.
options.rationale: The task document grows with the full array.

options.text: One checklistItems document per task, containing a map of item objects.
options.rationale: Moving the full map to a second document still concentrates the checklist in one document.

options.text: One checklistItems document per item with taskId, text and completed, indexed by taskId.
options.rationale: Each item has a separate document; the task index preserves the relationship for listing.

options.text: One tasks document containing the whole checklist as a JSON string.
options.rationale: Serializing the checklist as a string still grows one document.
